form.sheetDescription: Create a new product with details, pricing, media, and variants.
form.sheetDescriptionEdit: Update this product’s details, organization, pricing, and variants.

subtitleLocalePlaceholder.pl: Optional short line under the title
subtitleLocalePlaceholder.en: Optional short line under the title

titleLocale.pl: Name shown in the catalog, on the product page, and in the cart (Polish).
titleLocale.en: Name shown in the catalog, on the product page, and in the cart (English).

subtitleLocale.pl: Optional short line under the title on the product page (Polish).
subtitleLocale.en: Optional short line under the title on the product page (English).

descriptionLocale.pl: Full description shown on the storefront product page (Polish).
descriptionLocale.en: Full description shown on the storefront product page (English).

hints.tagsLocale: Optional labels for filtering in the admin ({locale}). Type a tag and click Add tag or press Enter.
hints.slug: URL path for this product (e.g. /products/gold-hoop). Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
hints.sku: Optional stock-keeping unit for single-variant products.
hints.subtitle: Optional short line under the title on the product page.
hints.description: Full description shown on the storefront product page.
hints.price: Sell price in PLN for a single-variant product.
hints.stockQuantity: How many units are available to sell (whole numbers only).
hints.primaryCategory: Main category in the catalog tree (breadcrumbs, SEO).
hints.additionalCategories: Optional extra categories where this product should also appear.
hints.collections: Merchandising collections (e.g. New arrivals and Sterling 925 at the same time).
hints.status: Draft products are hidden from the storefront; active products are visible to customers; archived products are not sold.
hints.productType: Single variant — one price and one stock count. Multiple variants — options (e.g. size) with separate price and stock per combination.
hints.tags: Optional labels for filtering and organization in the admin. Type a tag and click Add tag or press Enter.
hints.attributeProperty: Attribute from your catalog (e.g. weight, colour). Create it under Attributes if it is missing.
hints.attributeValue: Value of that property for this product only (e.g. 14 g or silver).
hints.optionName: Variant axis name shown in the storefront (e.g. Size, Metal).
hints.optionValues: One value per row (e.g. Srebrny). Variant rows appear as soon as you enter the Polish label. Switch the locale at the top to add the {locale} translation.
hints.variantSku: Optional stock-keeping unit for this option combination.
hints.variantPrice: Sell price in PLN for this combination (minimum 2.00 PLN when published).
hints.variantStock: Units available to sell for this variant row.

validation.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (e.g. gold-hoop).
validation.activePriceRequired: Active products: minimum price is 2.00 PLN.
validation.priceInvalid: Enter a valid PLN price (e.g. 199.00 — up to 2 decimal places).
validation.compareAtInvalid: Compare-at price must be empty or not less than the sell price.
validation.simpleVariantRequired: Enter price and stock for this product.
validation.optionsRequired: Add at least one option (e.g. Size) for products with variants.
validation.variantsRequired: Generate at least one variant row.
validation.LOCALE_TITLE_REQUIRED: Fill in this field for the selected language.
validation.submitBlockedDescription: Check highlighted fields and try again.
validation.duplicateAttribute: This attribute is already assigned to the product — each attribute can only appear once.
validation.duplicateSku: This SKU is already used by another variant.

toast.createSuccessDescription: The product was added to your catalog.
toast.errorDescription: Check the form and try again.
toast.duplicateHandle: This URL slug is already used by another product. If it is not in the list, click Create product again — the previous attempt may have been rolled back.
toast.duplicateSku: This SKU is already used by another variant.
toast.duplicateAttribute: The same attribute cannot be assigned to a product more than once.
toast.databaseSchemaOutdated: The database schema is out of date. Run migrations: bun run db:migrate

basic.name: Product Name
basic.subtitle: Subtitle

basic.title: Basic details

inventory.sellWhenOOS: Continue selling when out of stock
inventory.title: Inventory

media.hint: First image (or “main”) becomes the catalog thumbnail. Drag to reorder.
media.hintSharedVariants: Shown for every variant that has no gallery of its own. To use different photos per variant, upload them in the Variants section.
media.title: Media

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.hint: Pick attributes from your catalog (e.g. weight, colour) and set values for this product only.
attributes.hintSharedVariants: Shared attributes for the whole product (e.g. material). Per-variant values — e.g. weight — belong in the Variants section on each row.
attributes.emptyVariant: No attributes for this variant yet. Pick an attribute and value above, then click Add attribute.
attributes.empty: No values assigned yet. Pick an attribute and value above, then click Add attribute.
attributes.emptyNoCatalogAttributes: There are no attributes in your catalog yet. Create them under Attributes, then return here to assign them to this product.

pricing.title: Pricing & Inventory
pricing.variantsHint: Prices, SKU, and stock are set per variant below.

variantMode.title: Product type
variantMode.descriptionSimple: Single sellable version — one price, one SKU, one stock count.
variantMode.descriptionVariants: Sell multiple combinations (e.g. size, metal, finish).
variantMode.hintSimple: Best for one-of-a-kind pieces or products with no options.
variantMode.hintVariants: Define options, generate combinations, then set price and stock for each row.

options.title: Options
options.empty: Add an option such as Size or Metal to build variants.

variants.sectionHint: Each row is one variant (e.g. Silver, Gold plated). Set name, price, stock, and photos. Use the PL/EN picker at the top to translate names.
variants.listHint: Variant name in {locale}. Switch PL/EN at the top of the form to add the translation.
variants.imagesHint: Gallery for this variant only. If empty, the storefront uses shared photos from Media.
variants.attributesHint: Values for this variant only (e.g. weight for Silver vs Gold plated). Shared attributes go in the Attributes section below.
variants.title: Variants
